title: 调式并修复bug
problem_statement_md:
你的同事正试图编写一个程序，期望在输出三行"**GO**"。
然而，他还是Go的新手，在代码中犯了很多错误。

调试并修复代码，让输出正确。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Debug & Fix[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Your colleague tried to make a program that is intended to output "[b]GO[/b]" three times on separate lines.
However, he is still new to Go and has made a number of mistakes in the code.

Debug and fix the code to produce the desired output.
[note]The output should be in all caps.[/note]
